title: terebinthus rhoifolia
intro: Terebinthus rhoifolia, commonly known as Mastich, is a perennial plant native to the Mediterranean region, its name derived from the Greek word "mastiha," meaning mastic. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, making it effective in treating digestive issues, wounds, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Terebinthus rhoifolia include its ability to act as an expectorant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory agent, helping to relieve coughs, soothe skin irritations, and reduce swelling. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonene, beta-pinene, and beta-caryophyllene, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its aromatic flavor and fragrance.
